gap: No result ChatGPT got states that a station's kW limit can depend on how much battery you add: Anker's F3800 Plus page footnotes its 6,000 W output as '3,300W for single unit, 6,000W when working with 1 or more expansion batteries', and the extra batteries only fit certain models (for example, EcoFlow's 2,048 Wh DELTA 3 Max Plus Smart Extra Battery fits only the DELTA 3 Max Plus, DELTA 3 Ultra Plus and DELTA Gen4 3800).
standout_why: ChatGPT's saved chat lists no search query and no results, so it cited no rival pages. Its answer gives generic sizing bands (1–40+ kWh) and says 'A battery must be sized for both' kW and kWh. It names no product, no expansion-battery pairing, no limit on how far a station can grow, and does not say that adding batteries can raise output.
decides: If you start small and plan to add batteries later, the base unit has to be one the maker lists as expandable with a named battery. For anyone who needs about 6 kW of output, the Anker F3800 Plus only reaches 6,000 W with at least one BP3800 (3,840 Wh) added, not on its own. The BLUETTI Apex 300 (2,764.8 Wh, 3,840 W, 120/240 V) adds B300K batteries for 5,529.6 Wh at US$2,599. EcoFlow extra batteries are model-locked, so check the base model's name exactly.

findings.label: AC output limit tied to expansion battery
findings.value: 3,300 W for a single unit; 6,000 W with 1 or more expansion batteries
findings.source_title: Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus product page
findings.note: Footnote on the product page. The headline spec says 'AC Output Power (Total): 6000W Max'.

findings.label: Compatible expansion battery and count
findings.value: BP3800, up to 6 per unit, 3,840 Wh each; system 'expandable to 53.8kWh (12kW)'
findings.source_title: Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus product page
findings.note: My arithmetic: one unit plus 6 BP3800 = 7 × 3.84 = 26.9 kWh. 53.8 kWh = 14 × 3.84 kWh, which fits two units each with 6 batteries. The page does not say this outright. The 12 kW figure matches the two-unit bundle (12,000 W | 7,680 Wh).

findings.label: 240 V and generator limits
findings.value: 240 V output (NEMA L14-30R, 6,000 W max) cannot be used while charging via 120 V AC; Generator Adapter required and only supports a single F3800 Plus unit
findings.source_title: Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus product page
findings.note: Exclusions quoted from the page. Switchover times listed: 20 ms on a 120 V wall outlet; 30 ms from F3800 Plus to generator, 50 ms from generator to F3800 Plus.

findings.label: Home Power Panel / Double Power Hub mixing
findings.value: F3800 and F3800 Plus can be used with Double Power Hub and with Home Power Panel at the same time (FAQ: 'Yes'); Storm Guard and Local Energy Saver need a Home Power Panel
findings.source_title: Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus product page FAQ
findings.note: The FAQ also says solar panels can't recharge the unit through the Home Power Panel during an outage; connect panels directly to the unit.

findings.label: Base capacity, expansion and system maximum
findings.value: 2,764.8 Wh, 3,840 W; with one B300K, 5,529.6 Wh; '2–3 units and up to 18 batteries for up to 11.52kW output and 58kWh capacity'
findings.note: The page says solar input up to 4,000 W 'Requires a SolarX 4K', DC power needs Hub D1, and the AT1 panel powers essential circuits. Switchover is listed as '0ms' and elsewhere as '0ms or 20ms'. Expected to ship in late January.

findings.label: Price (BLUETTI US store)
findings.note: The US$1,499 and US$2,599 prices are from the product page. The 2× B300K price is from the Shopify store search via storecheck.py (https://www.bluettipower.com/products/apex-300-2-b300k).

findings.label: Compatible expansion batteries and limit
findings.value: B300K or B500K, up to 6 per unit; 2,560 Wh, 3,200 W standalone (3,600 W only with a compatible expansion battery or supported input); max 99.84 kWh with 3 units + 18 B500K + Hub A1
findings.note: The page says 'Standalone continuous AC output is 3,200W.' UPS is ≤15 ms and must be enabled in the app. Price US$1,099 (was US$1,399) from storecheck.py on the same date.

findings.product: EcoFlow DELTA 3 Max Plus Smart Extra Battery
findings.label: Which stations it fits
findings.value: Adds 2,048 Wh to DELTA 3 Max Plus, DELTA 3 Ultra Plus and DELTA Gen4 3800 only (models listed); US$859
findings.source_title: EcoFlow DELTA 3 Max Plus (2048Wh) Smart Extra Battery
findings.note: Text and price come from EcoFlow US Shopify store data via storecheck.py. The plain DELTA 3 Max and DELTA 3 Ultra are not on its list. The DELTA 3 Ultra series listing gives '3-11kWh Expandable Capacity' only for the Ultra Plus.

findings.label: Expandable range and price
findings.value: 2,048 Wh, 3,000 W, '2-10kWh Expandable Capacity', 10 ms auto-switch; US$1,149
findings.source_title: EcoFlow DELTA 3 Max Plus Portable Power Station (2048Wh)
findings.note: From EcoFlow US Shopify store data via storecheck.py.

findings.label: Compatible extra batteries
findings.value: '1-5kWh expandable with DELTA 3 Extra Battery, DELTA Pro 3 Extra Battery, DELTA 2 Extra Battery or DELTA 2 Max Extra Battery'; 1,800 W AC; US$579
findings.note: From EcoFlow US Shopify store data via storecheck.py. The product page itself returned HTTP 429, so I could not check whether this listing is the DELTA 3 Plus variant. Do not apply this to the separate DELTA 3 Classic listing (US$459), whose text says nothing about expansion.

findings.label: Auto start-stop compatibility
findings.value: Automatic start-stop works only with DELTA 3, DELTA 3 Plus and DELTA 3 Ultra Plus; not sold in California (CARB); US$689
findings.note: From EcoFlow US Shopify store data via storecheck.py.
